column1: # The game runs CI makes for each version (ci/smoke.sh runs them, ci/check-log.py checks each against ci/checks.tsv),
# in the order they run within a part, a job of its own in the full matrix (ci.yml); the fast job runs "server" alone.
# A row applies where its platform columns say (ci/plan.py); a run may have a row per platform where they differ.
# gates: all (every gating check that applies gates), own (only the gating checks that name the run in their runs
#   column), none (informational); "<gates> when <condition>" is none where the condition (ci/check-log.py) fails.
#   An informational run becomes a gate once it held on two extended runs in a row (CI-1).
# extended: yes for a run only with "extended" (a run by hand, or the release's).
# Platform columns: where the run applies (ci/plan.py). needs: the run is skipped unless one of these Modrinth
#   projects was fetched for it, or (a path) unless that file exists in a run directory before it.
# mods: what joins the test mods (ci/smoke.sh): fabric-api, testmod:<name>, modrinth:<loader>:<project>[@<version
#   id>],..., corpus[:advanced], drop:<jar glob>, standins[:own-loader], connector, fabricated-copy, energy,
#   seed:<run>/<path>, reuse:<run>; -testmods leaves the test mods out. {plugin_hosts}, {renderers} and
#   {fabric_renderers} are the version's pins ({renderers.sodium} the Sodium one). env: the harness's settings.
